_comment: Committed LLM-quality baselines (project-score-9 Phase 3). Update values only from a real measurement run; each entry records how it was produced.

retrievalEval.notes: Real chunk_transcript + SentenceTransformer embeddings + Qdrant query_points over an ephemeral collection. Zero LLM spend. Regression proof 2026-07-12: chunker broken to 120-char/0-overlap chunks -> recall@3 0.524, MRR 0.500, floor test FAILED as designed; reverted.
retrievalEval.rerun: cd services/summarizer && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/eval/test_retrieval_eval.py -s  (needs Qdrant reachable at QDRANT_HOST:QDRANT_PORT)

faithfulnessJudge.notes: Haiku fast-tier judge with claim-localized context selection. ~20 LLM calls, ~$0.02.

goldenEval.notes: Live baseline over the 10 entries still alive on YouTube (avg 0.710; range 0.460 review-airpods-pro to 0.890 science-black-holes). 10/20 dataset entries were found DEAD-LINKED (YouTube 404, verified via oembed 2026-07-14) and are marked disabled: true in videos.yaml — run_eval.py skips disabled entries so the weekly gate measures pipeline quality, not dataset rot. FOLLOW-UP: curate 10 replacement videos (fresh URLs + re-derived expectedTabs/requiredComponents/keyContent), re-baseline, and tighten failUnder. Runner fixes landed same day: the pipeline only runs while the SSE stream is consumed (poll-only clients hung forever), 401 -> re-auth retry, failed-status short-circuit.
goldenEval.produce: 1) docker compose up -d (healthy stack, EVAL_USER_PASSWORD set in .env)  2) python3 scripts/run_eval.py --output reports/ --publish-run golden-baseline-$(date +%Y%m%d)  3) copy the report's average into averageOverall + set measuredAt, set failUnder slightly below it (e.g. baseline - 0.05), and commit.
